svg.aria-label: One frame of the rougher sea: settings feed the spectrum pass, which makes each cascade's h0, its band only, when a setting changes; animate, FFT and assemble are Chapter 29's passes, unchanged, run three times. New are the foam pass, which keeps the larger of the Jacobian's new foam and what is left of last frame's, and the surface, which adds up every cascade's displacement, slopes and foam.
